lines_read.convention: Count each independent handwritten baseline in each source block/column separately; simultaneous left formula and right explanatory text count independently. Include page number (1), opening prose (7), heading (1), braced data (5), avec (1), At 0 formula (1), axiom prose (2), slanted note (4), row-a formula (1) and prose (5), first lower note (6, including inserted NB), tilde note (1), row-b formula lines (2) and prose (5), its insertion (1), bottom-left note (3), row-c formula (1) and prose (2), isolated cancellation (1), row-d formula (1) and prose (2). A label written on a formula baseline is part of that line; arrow superscripts and accents are not separate lines.
